requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
蜂鸣器（D6）每 3 秒响一次，按钮（D2）暂停/恢复
验收约定：D6使用无源蜂鸣器，音调1000Hz，每次持续100ms；初始运行且静音，累计运行3000ms后首次发声，此后每累计运行3000ms开始一次。D2使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平按下沿切换暂停/恢复，长按及松开不切换。暂停立即静音，保留计时和剩余鸣叫时长，恢复后继续，不能重新开始完整周期。响应及鸣叫时间容差20ms。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 press-edge toggles pause/resume; io_2 advances in 5ms steps while running and also during pause, preserving elapsed deltas per control step
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 (tone Hz) is 0 while paused; when running, first beep occurs after accumulated 3000ms of active running time, then beeps repeat every 3000ms with 100ms on-time at 1000Hz; pause immediately silences without restarting the full 3000ms period and resumes with preserved remaining on/off phase and remaining beep duration; all timing within 20ms tolerance
